title: G2 2024 B2B buyer survey on security history and assessments
statement:
G2's 2024 B2B buyer survey found that 81% of respondents considered a vendor's history of security breaches or incidents when evaluating software, while 48% reported closing purchases without a completed security or privacy assessment, supporting early, self-service security information rather than a badge-only signal. (Sell G2)
